title: Two End Sidebars
description: A design editor layout with a start Layers sidebar and two end ShellSidebar columns, a toggleable Properties panel and a narrow tools rail, where selecting a layer outlines it on a ShellMainFull canvas and shows its fields, and $stackCenter moves the header mode switcher to its own row at narrow widths. Use it for editors or builders that need inspector and toolbar panels stacked on the end side.
